const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='docs/quality/summary-qa/root/2026-11-05-batch-002957/expanded-iteration-13/reader-b.json'
A=[]
def q(i,part,ruling,sec,quote): A.append({'id':f'Q{i:02}','source_passages':[{'section':sec,'quotation':quote}],'answer':[{'part':part,'ruling':ruling,'evidence':sec}],'support':'supported','evidence':[sec]})
q(41,'Charismatic Recruit shortage','No. The Decree requires two warriors for Charismatic Recruit. If only one can be placed, the required action is not fully completed and Turmoil begins immediately.','Eyrie Decree','| Recruit | Clearing with a roost | Place **one warrior at one chosen roost** there; Charismatic must instead place **two warriors** there |\n\nIf any required action cannot be completed fully for any reason (including warrior/building supply), immediately enter **Turmoil**; do not skip that card or continue other Decree columns.')
q(42,'Guerrilla War','Alliance defending reverses dice assignment: Alliance uses higher die, attacker lower. Rolled hits remain capped by each side’s own warriors in battle; Guerrilla War does not bypass caps.','Alliance Guerrilla War / Battle','**Guerrilla War:** When Alliance defends, Alliance uses higher die and attacker lower; warrior caps still apply.\n\n**Roll:** Higher die is attacker’s rolled hits, lower defender’s; equal dice give equal results. Each side’s rolled hits are capped by its own warriors in battle. Alliance defending reverses the dice; Vagabond uses undamaged swords instead of warriors.')
q(43,'Supporters','Supporters separate face-down stack inspectable by Alliance; spent only for suit, not craft; not hand cards or hand limit.','Alliance Supporters','**Supporters** are a separate face-down stack, inspectable by Alliance. They can be spent only for suit; they do not count as hand cards or toward hand limit. With no bases on map, maximum **five supporters**; incoming cards beyond capacity are discarded. With any base, unlimited supporters.')
q(44,'Spread then Revolt same Birdsong','No. Complete all Revolts before beginning Spread; after spreading starts, cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so new sympathy cannot support same-Birdsong Revolt.','Alliance Birdsong','Both Revolt and Spread Sympathy take place **during Birdsong**. Complete **all Revolts before starting any Spread Sympathy**; each may be performed any number of times. Once spreading starts, you cannot return to Revolt this Birdsong, so newly spread sympathy cannot support a same-Birdsong Revolt.')
q(45,'Martial Law and Organize','Two separate players with two warriors each do not satisfy Martial Law: target needs at least three warriors belonging to one other player. Organize has no Martial Law cost.','Spread Sympathy / Organize','**Martial Law:** add one matching supporter if chosen clearing has at least three warriors of **one other player**.\n\nOrganize spends no supporters and has no sympathy-adjacency requirement or Martial Law cost; it still needs legal token placement.')
q(46,'Outrage and allied warriors','Placing warriors there alone does not trigger Outrage; moving only Vagabond pawn does not. Moving any warriors into sympathy triggers; thus allied warriors accompanying Vagabond trigger it as a warrior move; one matching hand card per affected move.','Outrage','Each time another player **removes sympathy** or **moves any warriors into a sympathetic clearing**, that player adds one matching hand card (birds count) to Supporters. Moving a group costs one card per affected move, rather than one per warrior. Merely battling there is no trigger unless sympathy is removed; placing warriors there and moving only Vagabond pawn do not trigger it.')
q(47,'Alliance Evening operations','Operations are Move, Battle, Recruit, Organize; take up to officers count in any order/repetition. Officers are not consumed. Recruit puts one warrior at one base clearing. After operations, draw one plus each uncovered bonus and discard to five.','Alliance Evening','**Evening:** The four military operations are **Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize**. Take **up to your number of officers** in operations, in any order and repetition. Officers stay on the board; taking an operation does not consume an officer. After operations, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.\n\n| Recruit | Place one warrior at one clearing with a base |')
q(48,'Pawn and remove-all effect','Pawn cannot be removed. Enemy effect removing all enemy pieces from its clearing damages three Vagabond items instead.','Vagabond pawn','Pawn is not a warrior, cannot rule or block rule, and cannot be removed. An enemy effect removing **all enemy pieces** from its clearing instead damages **three items**.')
q(49,'Vagabond hits/defenseless/excess','Rolled hit maximum equals all undamaged swords in Satchel whether face up or down; exhausted undamaged swords count; battle initiation still costs one ready undamaged sword. Defenseless if no undamaged swords. Hits damage one undamaged item each; ignore excess once none undamaged remain.','Vagabond battle and items','**Battle:** Exhaust one sword to initiate. Maximum rolled hits, attacking or defending, equals **all undamaged swords in Satchel, face up or face down**. As defender you are defenseless only with no undamaged swords. Take hits as item damage.\n\nOne hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.')
q(50,'Track items and action payments','Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately go to empty corresponding track if possible; each track max 3. Exhausting tracked item sends it to Satchel. Damaged item goes to Damaged without changing face. Actions require face-up undamaged item; damaged cannot pay.','Vagabond items','Face-up tea/coins/bags in Satchel immediately move to empty matching track space if possible; each track holds at most three of its type. Exhausting an item on track sends it to Satchel. Boots/swords/crossbows/torch/hammers are gained face up in Satchel. Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain. To exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.')
q(51,'Capacity','Satchel plus Damaged box limit = six plus two per face-up bag on bag track; track items excluded. Last Evening step after drawing/discarding, permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within capacity. No check on acquisition.','Vagabond Evening','4. **Capacity, the last step of Evening after drawing and discarding:** Satchel **plus Damaged box** may contain **six items plus two per face-up bag on its track**. Track items do not count toward load. Permanently remove chosen Satchel/Damaged items until within limit. Do not check capacity immediately upon acquiring an item.')
q(52,'Rest vs Refresh/Repair','Rest only if in forest; moves all damaged items to Satchel face up, ready tea/coins/bags to tracks. Does not flip undamaged exhausted items. Refresh flips exhausted items as specified during Birdsong; Repair costs hammer and moves one damaged item preserving face.','Vagabond actions','1. **Refresh:** First count tea **already face up on Refresh track**; flip two exhausted items face up per counted tea, then three more exhausted items. Tea refreshed during this step gives no extra refresh this step.\n\n1. If in forest, **Rest**: return all damaged items to Satchel and flip them face up; ready tea/coins/bags move to tracks if able. This does not refresh undamaged exhausted items.\n\n- **Repair:** Exhaust hammer; move one damaged item to Satchel **keeping current face**.')
q(53,'Aid','Exhaust any face-up undamaged item, give a card matching clearing to faction with pieces there (even Hostile). Then may take item from its Crafted Items box, but not required. Repeated Aid in same turn counts toward relationship spaces; one Aid counts only one improvement; final Allied follow-up Aid scores 2 VP.','Vagabond Aid / relationships','- **Aid:** Exhaust **one face-up, undamaged item of any type**, give a card matching your clearing to player with faction pieces there, even Hostile. May then take one item from their Crafted Items box face up into Satchel/track; no available item is required.\n\nTo advance a non-Hostile marker one space, Aid that faction as many times **in this same turn** as printed between current and next spaces. One Aid counts toward only one improvement. Advance and score VP printed in new space. At final space become **Allied**; each subsequent Aid to that faction scores **two VP**.')
q(54,'Allied powers','Each subsequent Aid to Allied faction scores 2 VP. May force its warriors to accompany movement, following their restrictions and not on move specified alone. At battle start as attacker may use one Allied faction’s warriors to add to all undamaged swords for hit limit; may attack another enemy, cannot attack that ally.','Vagabond Allied benefits','**Allied benefits:** Aid gains two VP, warriors may accompany movement, and participating warriors increase the attacking rolled-hit limit as follows:\n\n- **Move:** May force warriors of **one** Allied faction to accompany the pawn to its destination clearing. They follow their own movement restrictions, including rule and Eyrie tie advantage. They cannot accompany a move specified to be alone. Moving them into sympathy triggers Outrage.\n- **Attack with an increased hit limit:** At the start of battle **as attacker**, you may treat warriors of **one** Allied faction in the battle clearing as your own. **Add those warriors to all your undamaged swords to determine your maximum rolled hits**. They can join against a different enemy; you cannot use an ally’s warriors to attack that ally itself.')
q(55,'Allied battle hit comparison','If using allied warriors as own in battle and remove more allied warriors than Vagabond items damaged in that battle, ally becomes Hostile at battle end. Equal numbers do not.','Taking hits with an ally','**Taking hits with an ally:** In a battle using Allied warriors as your own, you may absorb hits by removing those warriors or damaging your items. If you remove **more allied warriors than items you damage in that battle**, the ally becomes Hostile **at battle end**. This overrides ordinary hostility timing for those friendly warriors taken as hits against the other enemy. Equal numbers do not trigger the rule.')
q(56,'Vagabond craft','Cannot craft fox+rabbit from one clearing because pawn must match every icon; one clearing cannot pay mixed suits. Pawn can activate repeatedly, but pay hammer per icon. If craft an item, may take face-up and immediately use for another Daylight action if cost/requirements met.','Vagabond Craft','- **Craft:** Exhaust one hammer per crafting icon; pawn acts as crafting piece matching current clearing, and may activate repeatedly despite normal once-per-turn crafting limit. Clearing must match **all icons**; cannot craft mixed fox/rabbit/mouse requirements from one clearing. When you craft an item, you may immediately take that item face up into Satchel/track and **use it for another Daylight action immediately**, if its cost and other requirements are met. Need supply item as usual.')
q(57,'Characters','Thief starts boot/torch/tea/sword; Steal costs torch, random hand card from player with faction pieces in clearing. Tinker boot/torch/bag/hammer; Day Labor costs torch, takes discard card matching clearing (bird qualifies). Ranger boot/torch/crossbow/sword; Hideout exhaust torch, repairs three items preserving faces, ends Daylight immediately and starts Evening.','Vagabond characters','| Base character | Starting items | Special action |\n|---|---|---|\n| Thief | boot, torch, tea, sword | **Steal:** exhaust torch to take random hand card from player with faction pieces in your clearing |\n| Tinker | boot, torch, bag, hammer | **Day Labor:** exhaust torch to take discard-pile card matching clearing; bird always qualifies |\n| Ranger | boot, torch, crossbow, sword | **Hideout:** exhaust torch to repair three items, keeping their faces; immediately end Daylight and begin Evening |')
q(58,'Ruin removal and build','When last hidden item taken, remove ruin and free building slot. Ruins can only be removed when explicitly allowed; ordinary building placement cannot remove one.','Clearings and Explore','Ruins block their slots and can be removed only when explicitly allowed.\n\n**Explore:** Exhaust torch in ruin’s clearing. Take one hidden item face up into Satchel or track; score one VP if an item taken. Remove ruin when its last item is taken, freeing the building slot.')
q(59,'Coalition partner','Coalition partners are not enemies, so cannot be chosen as battle enemy. Coalition does not confer Allied relationship powers.','Vagabond coalition','If partner wins, you also win, including if partner wins through dominance. Coalition partners are not enemies. A Hostile partner becomes Indifferent. Coalition does not by itself grant Allied relationship powers.')
q(60,'Scenario VP','First removed non-Hostile warrior makes faction Hostile and yields zero ordinary removal VP and no Infamy for that warrior. Second warrior is Hostile and gives one Infamy VP, no ordinary warrior VP. Building yields 1 ordinary removal VP +1 Infamy =2. Total 3 VP.','Scoring / Hostile','| Removed enemy piece | Ordinary removal VP |\n|---|---|\n| Warrior | **0 VP** |\n| Building | **1 VP** |\n\n**Infamy:** During battle on your own turn, score **one extra VP per hostile piece removed**, except warrior that first made faction Hostile. **Each hostile building/token removed in battle on your turn normally scores two VP: one removal VP plus one Infamy. A hostile warrior scores one Infamy, except the warrior that first caused Hostile status.**')
q(61,'Normal Vagabond move boots','Hostile buildings alone add no boot: cost one boot. If destination has hostile warriors, pay one extra boot regardless of how many hostile factions/warriors; total two boots.','Vagabond Move / Hostility','- **Move:** Exhaust one boot, plus **one extra boot** if destination has any warriors of any Hostile faction (also for forced moves).\nHostile status requires extra boot for moves into hostile warriors, not merely buildings/tokens.')
q(62,'Dominance taking/action allowance','Taking dominance to hand does not activate it; taking and activation are separate and neither requires faction action allowance.','Dominance','During own Daylight, spend matching card to take available dominance into hand. Available **bird dominance remains bird**, so payment must be bird; a bird hand card can pay for non-bird dominance. Activation and taking are separate, neither requires a faction action allowance.')
q(63,'Ownership','Faction-piece ownership cannot change; each player owns chosen faction and its listed faction pieces except items. Items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces; possessing item does not make it faction-owned.','Components','**Faction-piece ownership cannot change**: each player owns the faction chosen in setup and its listed faction pieces, except items; possessing an item does not make it faction-owned. Items are not faction pieces or enemy pieces.')
q(64,'Crafted card destination','Immediate-effect card resolves then is discarded; item token stays in Crafted Items. Persistent card stays in play area with effect and is outside hand, cannot be spent/discarded/used otherwise unless instructed.','Craft','- Immediate effect (paper box): resolve, then discard the **crafting card**. An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception. The item token stays; the crafting card is discarded.\n- Persistent effect (stone box): keep card in your play area and gain its text, subject to personal duplicate check. Its card is outside your hand and cannot be spent/discarded/used for another purpose unless explicitly instructed.')
q(65,'Ambush/dominance crafting and use','Neither can be crafted. Defender ambush gives two immediate hits; attacker ambush foils defending ambush, matching clearing. Dominance activates to change victory condition or is spent for suit.','Craft','- **Ambush cards cannot be crafted:** the defender may play one for two immediate hits, or the attacker may play one to foil a defending ambush, matching the clearing. **Dominance cards cannot be crafted:** activate one to change victory condition, or spend it for suit.')
q(66,'Setup order details','Randomly determine starting player and seating; put score markers at zero; dice nearby. Faction setup order is Marquise/Eyrie/Alliance/Vagabond and distinct from turn order.','Setup','1. Choose factions; determine starting player and seating randomly. Take faction boards and their listed pieces.\n2. Put score markers at 0.\n6. Distribute overview cards as desired; put battle dice nearby.\n7. Set up factions in their letter order: Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, Vagabond. Setup order is distinct from turn order.')
q(67,'Ordinary win timing','First to 30 wins immediately on any player’s turn; no need to finish action/phase/turn.','30 VP','**30 VP:** First to 30 wins immediately, on any player’s turn.')
q(68,'Battle initiation','Choose a clearing where you have warriors or Vagabond pawn and an enemy to be defender. Need not rule it.','Battle','**Battle (4.3):** Choose a clearing with your warriors or pawn and an enemy there as defender. **Battle does not require you to rule the clearing.**')
q(69,'Effect ordering','Attacker chooses order for both sides’ applicable before-roll and after-roll effects when both have effects at that timing. Side taking hits chooses order of effects triggered by its own pieces’ removal.','Battle','**Before-roll effects:** Resolve applicable effects; attacker chooses order if both have them.\n**After-roll effects:** Resolve effects affecting battle that do not say “before rolling”; attacker chooses order if both have them.\nThe side taking hits chooses its own removal order, and chooses order of effects triggered by its pieces’ removal.')
q(70,'Ignored hits','In Count Hits, add extra hits then subtract ignored hits.','Battle Count Hits','**Count hits:** Add extra hits (uncapped by warriors), subtract ignored hits.')
q(71,'Crafted item token','Non-Vagabond crafting faction takes corresponding token from map supply into its Crafted Items box, scores printed VP subject to Eyrie exception; ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items.','Craft items','An item card requires the corresponding **item token** in the map supply, or it cannot be crafted. Take the item token into Crafted Items and score the VP printed on the card, subject to Eyrie exception. The item token stays; the crafting card is discarded. Ordinary factions do not exhaust crafted items as Vagabond does.')
q(72,'Eyrie/Alliance crafting pieces and suits','Eyrie activates roosts; Alliance sympathy. Crafting-piece suit comes from its clearing, not card suit. Three-color question mark accepts any suit. Each piece at most once per turn.','Craft','**Every crafting piece gets its suit from the clearing containing it.** The card’s **bottom-left crafting icons** require pieces of those clearing suits; the card’s own suit does not define the cost.\nFor **each icon**, activate **one workshop, roost or sympathy in a clearing matching that icon’s suit**, respectively. Combine eligible pieces as needed, but **each piece may activate only once per turn**.\nA **three-color question-mark icon** accepts any suit.')
q(73,'Mobilize and Daylight order','Mobilize adds one hand card to Supporters; without base keep max five and discard incoming overflow; any base means no cap. Daylight Craft/Mobilize/Train in any order and number.','Alliance Daylight','**Daylight:** Any order and number:\n- **Craft** from hand with sympathy.\n- **Mobilize:** Add one hand card to Supporters. With no base on map, keep at most five supporters and discard incoming overflow; with any base, the stack has no cap.\n- **Train during Daylight:** Spend a **hand card** matching a clearing with a base to place one supply warrior in Officers box. Supporters cannot pay Train.')
q(74,'Eyrie evening','Score VP shown on rightmost empty roost-track space, draw one plus uncovered bonuses, discard to five. This normal Evening happens after Turmoil too.','Eyrie Evening','**Evening, even after turmoil:** Score the VP on rightmost empty roost-track space. Draw one plus uncovered draw bonuses; discard down to five.')
q(75,'Vagabond battle payment','Initiating Daylight Battle exhausts one face-up undamaged sword. Exhausted undamaged sword counts toward hit maximum but cannot pay action cost because payment requires face-up undamaged.','Vagabond Battle','**Battle:** Exhaust one sword to initiate. Maximum rolled hits, attacking or defending, equals **all undamaged swords in Satchel, face up or face down**.\nTo exhaust for an action, choose a face-up **undamaged** item and flip it down. Damaged items cannot pay actions.')
q(76,'Turn sequence','Birdsong then Daylight then Evening; turns clockwise, so next player clockwise starts after Evening.','Turn Structure','Take turns clockwise: **Birdsong → Daylight → Evening**.')
q(77,'Hit damage','Each hit damages one undamaged item of Vagabond’s choice; it goes to Damaged box without changing face. Already-damaged items cannot take another hit; excess hits ignored when no undamaged items remain.','Vagabond items','Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**. One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.')
q(78,'Alliance operations count and Recruit','Up to number of officers in operations, any order/repetition; officers not consumed. One Recruit operation places one warrior at one clearing with a base.','Alliance Evening','**Evening:** The four military operations are **Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize**. Take **up to your number of officers** in operations, in any order and repetition. Officers stay on the board; taking an operation does not consume an officer.\n| Recruit | Place one warrior at one clearing with a base |')
q(79,'Vagabond action allowance','Vagabond Daylight allows any order and number of actions as ready undamaged items permit; no fixed action-type order, and action types may be repeated.','Vagabond Daylight','**Daylight:** Any order/number, as ready undamaged items permit:')
q(80,'Strike cost','Strike exhausts one crossbow, face-up and undamaged; exhausted or damaged crossbow cannot pay.','Vagabond Strike','- **Strike:** Exhaust crossbow to remove one enemy warrior in clearing. Only if that enemy has no warriors there may you remove another of its faction pieces instead.')

    f.seek(-3,2); f.truncate()
